note: Pre-registrations for campaign #563. Registered before any of these levers took a reading, which is the whole of what makes a verdict worth anything. Checked in CI by `python tools/mission_cost/experiment.py verify`.

experiments.lever: Cap an agent context at 80 requests and hand off to a fresh dispatch.

readings.note: Two declared transcripts, both resolved by containment and uncontested: the design and authoring context (agent-aa49c0aa114d448ee, 133 requests, 17930749 billable tokens) and the tests, validation and draft-pull-request context (agent-a5a25505f12780ff8, 82 requests, 6688723 billable tokens). The guards report is byte-identical to the merge base 00cd59ddaade07ceb0571f63559387c376adf0b2, measured by running the branch's own quantick-guards binary in both trees. Excluded, and the exclusion is error mode E14 of docs/quality/mission-cost/method.md: the ai-review and code-review contexts dispatched after the second claim closed, and the ledger context that took this reading, all of which start after the last claim's ended_at and so are outside the claimed window. The same under-count #567 recorded on itself. It makes both the measured total and the counterfactual smaller; it does not favour the lever, because the counterfactual is reconstructed from the same under-counted vector. On the reading instant: the measurement was taken at 2026-09-21T11:55Z, which is earlier than L1's registered_at of 12:00:00Z. That registration instant is a round placeholder -- the commit that registered L1 landed at 11:07:22Z -- and the schema refuses a reading that precedes its registration, so taken_at is pinned to the registration instant rather than backdated or invented later. The lever was registered before the mission ran, which is the fact the refusal exists to protect.

experiments.note: The -45.9% is #566's population-level arithmetic over 520 subagent contexts, not a per-mission figure. The graded mission is priced on its own context vector; the prediction is here so that a reading that comes out far from it is visible as a surprise rather than quietly renamed the expectation.

experiments.lever: Take 10,000 tokens off the standing frame every request pays.
experiments.note: Disjoint from L1 and L3 under protocol section 8, so it may be in probation beside either of them. Its mechanism reading is the measured fall in opening cache reads per request; the protocol states why that is used as the trim and where it is conservative.

experiments.lever: Cut the review rounds the chain cannot show a catch for.

reduction.removes: The third and later arch-review and ai-review passes at medium and below. Every diff still gets one full reading per review at the draft head and one at the final head; what goes is the extra projection refresh a repair in more than one wave forces. Step 0, delivery-review at medium, the zero-open-threads gate and full-head CI are untouched.
reduction.risk: A defect introduced by a repair batch and visible only to a reader who re-read the whole diff a third time; under the budget that reader does not run. The honest claim is not measured to catch, not proven not to catch. Bounded by two full readings per review, the second at the final head, by the Blocker exception that authorises a third pass, by step 0 running in every pass, and by the unchanged thread, ship-gate and CI gates.
reduction.justified_by: docs/quality/velocity/round-budget.md: durable quantick-review-report:v1 counts per pull request over six missions, each removed pass measured inside the reviewing context and windowed by its own report timestamps, priced over four references at the smallest of them, PR 578 at 21 requests.

experiments.note: Not disjoint from L1: both move N. Whichever runs second is graded against the state the first left, never against the original baseline. `reduces_review` is true, so the three honesty fields are owed by the mission that runs it and `verify` refuses the ledger once a probation branch is named with any of them empty. Needs MIN_REFERENCE_N = 3 reference missions with the removed contexts measured before a verdict is reachable; #566 measured one (#571's three AI-review rounds at 11.5%) and two delivery-review shares at 9.1% and 2.9%, which is the honest starting point and not yet the three this form requires.
